mentions.h: BILL LUCAS "... a bold spirit in a loyal breast"
Terror in a tree lined lane
mentions.note: relived the 1959 occasion at Belgrave Hall forty years on; the item presents her as the Marianne of the cutting (printed differently, not merged)
later name of Marianne Dew, per caption

photos.c: Right:Suzy and Leo Coy, Denny Manning, Snowy Brooks, Don Turner, Alan Black (obscured), Alan Mead, Charlie Henn and Marianne Black listen to the speeches.

Left: Enjoying the occasion.  Pat Mead, Tony Binda, Marianne Black, Gerry North, Alan Black, the late Laurie O'Hara, George Piddington, Charlie Henn, Ted Pallant, Chris Steer, Charlie Manning.

Sadly this was the last time that we saw Laurie O'Hara.  He died the following day while out running.
